name: Verdant Voice
body:
Prerequisite(s): Bardic performance class feature, Knowledge (nature) 5 ranks

Benefit(s): You can combine traditional fey songs and chants into your bardic performances, allowing them to affect creatures of the plant type with mind-affecting bardic performances and inspirations. However, doing so requires you to expend 1 additional round of bardic performance each round you start and maintain a performance augmented by verdant voice.

Normal: Plant creatures are immune to your mind-affecting bardic performances and inspirations.
